title: Detailed football
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Football base - bright white/cream sphere -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="#F5F0E0" stroke="#D4C9A8" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pentagonal patches - classic football pattern -->
  <!-- Center pentagon -->
  <polygon points="50,32 60,39 58,51 42,51 40,39" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Top pentagon -->
  <polygon points="50,10 58,18 55,27 45,27 42,18" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Top-left pentagon -->
  <polygon points="18,30 28,24 36,30 34,40 22,40" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Top-right pentagon -->
  <polygon points="82,30 78,40 66,40 64,30 72,24" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom-left pentagon -->
  <polygon points="16,58 28,54 34,64 30,74 18,74" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom-right pentagon -->
  <polygon points="84,58 80,74 68,74 64,64 72,54" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom pentagon -->
  <polygon points="50,90 58,82 55,72 45,72 42,82" fill="#2A2A3A" stroke="#4A4A5A" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Hexagonal connecting lines (seams) -->
  <!-- Seams from center pentagon -->
  <line x1="50" y1="32" x2="50" y2="27" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="39" x2="64" y2="30" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="51" x2="64" y2="64" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="51" x2="36" y2="64" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="39" x2="36" y2="30" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Seams connecting top area -->
  <line x1="58" y1="18" x2="72" y2="24" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="18" x2="28" y2="24" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="27" x2="64" y2="30" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="27" x2="36" y2="30" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Seams connecting bottom area -->
  <line x1="55" y1="72" x2="64" y2="64" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="72" x2="36" y2="64" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="82" x2="68" y2="74" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="82" x2="30" y2="74" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Side seams -->
  <line x1="34" y1="40" x2="34" y2="64" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="40" x2="66" y2="64" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Extra seam detail lines -->
  <line x1="28" y1="24" x2="22" y2="40" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="24" x2="78" y2="40" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="74" x2="28" y2="54" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="82" y1="74" x2="72" y2="54" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Small hexagonal patches between pentagons -->
  <polygon points="30,15 35,12 38,16 36,21 31,21 29,17" fill="#F5F0E0" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <polygon points="70,15 65,12 62,16 64,21 69,21 71,17" fill="#F5F0E0" stroke="#C8BFA0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Subtle highlight/shine on ball -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="35" rx="12" ry="8" fill="white" opacity="0.35" transform="rotate(-20 38 35)"/>
  
  <!-- Cute cheek blushes to make it endearing -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="56" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFB3B3" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="56" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFB3B3" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Small cute face on the football -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="48" r="3" fill="#2A2A3A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="48" r="3" fill="#2A2A3A"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="47" r="1" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="47" r="1" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M44,56 Q50,62 56,56" fill="none" stroke="#2A2A3A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
